```{r setup, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(deSolve)
library(patchwork)


# 1. Define the cobweb plotting function with custom labels
cobweb_plot_labeled <- function(f, x0, n_iter = 20, n_labels = 4, x_min = 0, x_max = 1) {
  # Generate points for the curve
  x_vals <- seq(x_min, x_max, length.out = 1000)
  y_vals <- sapply(x_vals, f)

  # Plot the function f(x), suppressing the default x-axis using xaxt = "n"
  plot(x_vals, y_vals, type = "l", col = "blue", lwd = 2,
       xaxt = "n", # Turns off the default x-axis
       xlab = "", ylab = expression(u[n+1]),
       main = "Cobweb Plot with Sequence Labels",
       xlim = c(x_min, x_max), ylim = c(x_min, x_max))

  # Add the y = x reference line
  lines(x_vals, x_vals, col = "black", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

  # Initialize variables to track the sequence
  x <- x0
  y <- 0
  u_sequence <- numeric(n_iter + 1)
  u_sequence[1] <- x0

  # Iteratively draw the cobweb lines
  for (i in 1:n_iter) {
    y_next <- f(x)

    # Draw vertical and horizontal lines
    lines(c(x, x), c(y, y_next), col = "red", lwd = 1.2)
    lines(c(x, y_next), c(y_next, y_next), col = "red", lwd = 1.2)

    # Store the value and update for next loop
    u_sequence[i + 1] <- y_next
    x <- y_next
    y <- y_next
  }

  # 2. Add the custom x-axis labels
  # Ensure we don't try to plot more labels than we have sequence values
  n_labels <- min(n_labels, n_iter + 1)

  # Create the subscript expressions u[0], u[1], u[2], etc. dynamically
  label_expressions <- parse(text = paste0("u[", 0:(n_labels - 1), "]"))

  # Draw the custom axis at the exact sequence locations
  axis(side = 1,
       at = u_sequence[1:n_labels],
       labels = label_expressions,
       col.axis = "darkred", font.axis = 2)

  # Optional: Drop lines to the x-axis to make the labels perfectly clear
  for(i in 1:n_labels) {
    lines(c(u_sequence[i], u_sequence[i]), c(0, u_sequence[i]),
          col = "gray", lty = 3)
  }
}
```
